The '''''Urmenung 300''''', also known as a '''''Urmi''''', was a heavily armed and armored [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] that was popular among people who liked their [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to be a combination of security and luxury. It had a three-pods-on-a-disk configuration. [[Luewet Wuul]] owned one and used it to meet [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on [[Crossing Lanes Station]].
